description:
Desktop workbench for Grok Build CLI — sessions, projects, media, automations (Tauri 2 · unofficial).

Grok App is not an official xAI product. It wraps the local Grok Build CLI (grok agent stdio) into a desktop workbench: sessions, projects, permissions, media previews, and scheduled tasks. Manage multiple projects and sessions, review permission requests, preview rich media, run scheduled tasks, and interact with the agent through a Chinese/English Tauri desktop interface.
Grok App v0.2.51
Highlight: Rewound chats keep their new replies, and model menus use a fresh catalog.
中文 · 亮点： 回退后的对话保留新回复，模型菜单采用更新的目录。
Fixed
- Rewound replies no longer return after you send a new message.
- Official model menus use the newest available catalog.
- CLI bulk import counts eligible sessions and reports complete import failures.
- Markdown paste keeps block structure and stops formatting the next text.
中文 · 修复
- 回退后发送新消息，不再重新显示已丢弃的旧回复。
- 官方模型菜单采用最新可用目录。
- CLI 批量导入只统计符合条件的会话，全部失败时会显示错误。
- Markdown 粘贴保留块结构，后续输入不再沿用粘贴内容的格式。
